title: Housing and registration
text: Housing demand can be high in major German cities. Renters should check lease terms carefully, including whether rent is listed as warm rent or cold rent, whether utilities are included, and what notice periods apply. After moving in, many newcomers need to complete local registration with the city. It is important to keep written lease documents and proof of address.

title: Preparing rental documents
text: Prospective renters in Germany often prepare proof of identity, proof of finances, recent bank statements, and employment or enrollment documentation. In competitive markets, being organized and replying quickly can improve the chance of securing a viewing or lease.

title: Moving to Germany: first steps
text: Visa and residence steps depend on nationality and purpose of stay, such as studying, working, or job seeking. Users should verify the exact path through official government resources. For longer stays, residence-related steps may continue after arrival, and local registration may be part of the process.
